newsitem.title: ALBANIA: OSCE mission to meet Albanian ministers on ship.
newsitem.headline: OSCE mission to meet Albanian ministers on ship.

text.p: European mediator Franz Vranitzky planned to meet Albanian government ministers on Friday aboard an Italian warship off the Balkan country's Adriatic coast as part of international efforts to halt more than a month of political violence .

A spokeswoman for Vranitzky's Organisation for Security and Cooperation in Europe mission told reporters by telephone the former Austrian chancellor had flown from Vienna to the Italian port of Brindisi.
She said Vranitzky was flying by helicopter to the ship where he would meet senior Albanian officials, including newly appointed Prime Minister Bashkim Fino and Foreign Minister Arjan Starova.
President Sali Berisha, she said, would not be in attendance.
Albanian officials said the prime minister was due to give a news conference on Friday morning in Tirana but his exact timetable and whereabouts were unknown.
The spokeswoman said it was hoped representatives of rebels in the southern port of Vlore would take part in the talks. Vlore was the scene of some of the worst violence to date.
Vranitzky met Berisha in Tirana last week and had urged him to avoid violence in dealing with the rebellion. A top-level European Union mission also came to Tirana.
He had planned to return to the Albanian capital on Thursday but was prevented from travelling by the deterioriating security situation and the closure of Tirana airport.
Sporadic shooting reverberated through central Tirana on Friday morning but the city appeared calmer than the previous day.
Berisha and Albania's new all-party government have appealed to Europe's NATO members for military assistance to restore order.
